Test build of the sign-in fixes for the 1.0.2 release, for the OnePlus test phone. It is a pre-release, so it does not replace the latest stable version.

## What to check

- Tap the eye icon on the password field while "Signing in…" is showing. It should switch between showing and hiding the password.
- If the server is asleep, sign-in should retry on its own. If the connection stalls, the form should unlock after about 40 seconds with a message.
- After sign-in, the home screen should load your organizations.

## Download

Install `TaskForge-1.0.2-personal-oneplus-live-3-arm64-v8a.apk`. Use the universal APK only if the arm64 one will not install.

Demo account: `admin@taskforge.dev` with the password `TaskForge2024!`.
